faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got questions about Getly? We have answers.
faq.a1: Getly is a fintech super app for modern travellers, immigrants, and professionals. It combines one global multi-currency wallet with instant virtual cards, global eSIM internet, flight booking, hotel stays, travel protection, and digital visas.
faq.q2: How do I fund my Getly wallet?
faq.a2: You can top up your wallet instantly using local debit cards, bank payment options, or global payment rails.
faq.q3: How does the global eSIM work?
faq.a3: Getly provides instant digital eSIM profiles for 180+ countries. Once selected in the app, scan the QR code or tap auto-install to connect to local high-speed mobile networks immediately.
faq.q4: Can I book flights and hotels using my wallet balance?
faq.a4: Yes! Getly allows you to search, compare, and book flights across 400+ international carriers and 1,000,000+ verified hotels directly using your multi-currency balance.
